newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Telekom, NTT enter joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Telekom, NTT enter joint venture.

text.p: Telekom Malaysia Bhd said on Tuesday it had entered into a joint venture with Japan's Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corporation to provide services for intelligent buildings in Malaysia.

In a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange, Telekom said a new joint venture company, Meganet Communications Sdn Bhd, would help develop systems for "intelligent buildings" within Malaysia's proposed information technology hub, the Multimedia Super Corridor (MSC).
The initial equity structure of Meganet would have Telekom holding 70 percent of the shares, and NTT 30 percent.
"Upon completion of the new Telekom Malaysia headquarters project, or when other projects have been secured by Meganet, NTT has an option to increase its equity up to 49 percent," said Telekom.
Meganet would have a paid-up capital of 11 million ringgit.
The two companies would join forces to develop Asynchronous Transfer Mode Local Area Network technology in the MSC to deliver multimedia services, said Telekom.
